name: adx_trend_vix_falling_destress_btc_eth_sol_bnb
rationale: Crypto trends accelerate as cross-asset volatility deflates (risk re-entering the system). Rather than a static low-vix level, we mark the TRANSITION with vix_level cross_down (de-stressing), then require ADX above a strength floor to confirm a real trend. Disconfirmer: a control run removes the vix_level cross_down gate — if ADX-floor trades earn the same outside vol-collapse windows, the de-stress transition is not driving returns and this is trend-following. Using cross_down here is the drift-safe choice for a transition signal; a separate static-level variant exists elsewhere.
catalyst: vix_level crosses down (volatility deflating) while ADX is above its strength floor
